scope: Production shared scene UI, 22 referenced native resource choices, explicit capability routing, supported and refused conversion, detached playable build proof, acknowledgement/import/Undo/Redo, stale resource/source/project guards, cancellation and protected Save As. No browser layout or cartridge acceptance claim.

results.name: Scene conversion metadata is optional, bounded and cannot imply an undeclared convert operation
Map and background share one panel with explicit output kind and preserved background API
Visible Find maps lists the 22 referenced native maps and distinguishes unsupported semantics without authoring changes
Map discovery route opens shared controls without finding, converting, importing or playing maps
Supported native map preview exposes exact identity, resource, collision and actual single-room compile proof
Unsupported native collision remains listed with its reason and cannot preview or import
Acknowledged map import adds one excluded canonical scene, one Undo and reversible Redo without changing runtime settings
Changing the selected native resource clears stage, acknowledgement and export eligibility
Source changes during native resource inspection cancel old work and clear stale choices
Explicit cancel prevents an older map inspection from replacing newer results
Changing maps while conversion is pending prevents stale preview publication
Project changes during or after map preview refuse stale import without discarding the newer project
Wrong source, native resource and static-viewer backend cannot masquerade as a map preview
Map project and evidence downloads are separate and never load the playable adaptation into the editor
Map Save As preserves busy, cancellation and failure outcomes and suppresses late status after source change
Switching conversion kinds clears map records and cannot route old map output into background import
